brief:
The Israeli military said it killed two suspected shooters near Hebron in the occupied West Bank, according to Middle East Eye. The military imposed a cordon in the area and conducted searches following the incident, a statement said.

No further details were provided about the circumstances of the attack the two were suspected of carrying out or when it occurred.
dek: Israeli military says forces kill suspected shooters near Hebron The Israeli military said that it killed two suspected of carrying out an attack near Hebron, occupied West Bank. A cordon had been imposed in the area alongside searches, it said in a statement.
title: Israeli forces kill two suspected shooters near Hebron
